name: Falcon

abilityDetails.Reduce Defensive AA: Savunma yetenek doğruluğunu belirtilen güçte azaltır.
abilityDetails.Bleed: Zamanla doğrudan fiziksel kanama hasarı verir.
abilityDetails.Incinerate: Zamanla enerji tabanlı yakma hasarı verir ve zırhı yok sayar.
abilityDetails.Fragility: Gelen saldırıların kritik hasar oranını artırır ve blok yeterliliğini %50 azaltır.

signatureAbility:
Exo-8
Redwing's Lock On lasts 2 seconds longer and provides an additional [731.01 - 2,437.93] Critical Rating.

abilitySections.title: Enhanced Synergy Bonuses
content: Falcon is a master scout and is always ready to lend a hand. His Synergy Bonuses all provide an additional +3% Attack rating each.

abilitySections.title: Recon Scan
content: To begin a Recon Scan, dash back and hold Block. If Block is held for 1.2 seconds the opponent gains a Lock On charge for 14 seconds. While Lock On is active, Falcon's attacks Passively reduce the opponent's Defensive Ability Accuracy by 100%.
Lock On gains +40% duration while fighting Science Champions but suffers -20% duration while fighting Mutants.
Once Lock On ends, it goes on Cooldown for 8 seconds.
Falcons Basic Attacks Gain +[13,663] Attack Rating while Locked On to the Opponent.

abilitySections.title: On Opponent Evade
content: Falcon's scanning system in his goggles Recalibrates each time the opponent triggers a Passive Evade, increasing Falcon's Critical Damage Rating by [175.53] indefinitely.
While Redwing is active any Evade that the Opponent Fails to trigger will increase Falcon's Critical Damage Rating by [175.53] indefinitely.

abilitySections.title: Special Attacks
content: If Redwing is Locked On, Falcon's Special Attacks gain additional Zeroed In effects.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 1
content: 100% chance to inflict a Bleed Debuff, dealing [11,035.5] Direct Damage over 3.5 seconds.
Zeroed In: 100% chance to inflict an additional Bleed.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 2
content: Opponent's Physical Resistance is reduced by 100% during this attack.
Zeroed In: +[1,069.44] Critical Damage Rating during the attack. Additionally the Second hit of this Attack gains 100% Critical Chance.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 3
content: 100% chance to inflict an Incinerate Debuff, dealing [16,816] Energy Damage over 10 seconds. Incinerate also removes Perfect Block Chance and reduces Block Proficiency by 50%.
Zeroed In: 100% chance to inflict a 25 second Fragility Debuff. Attacking a Fragile Opponent grants +[1,178.57] Critical Damage Rating and reduces Block Proficiency by 50%.
